answer: As a business, farming 761 masks has one line of expense, 73056 POA locked away, and no line of revenue. The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Where the farms spot a gap, Clay digger clay brick assay fired in the clay pit finds a record, and the record is each clay brick is a firing record witnessed by the inspector. The farm's forge is its mask, its nadir its bribe, its nectar its alibi — and the panel checks the alibi first, because alibis break first. The threshold has all epoch to wait, and the farm has no proof to bring; the waiting is the verdict.
